Russia Strikes Ukraine Security HQ; Tensions Rise with Germany

Russia launched drone attacks targeting Ukraine's security service headquarters in Kyiv, with reports indicating at least five people were injured. President Zelenskyy stated the drone was directed towards the SBU chief's office and ordered retaliatory action. In parallel, Russia announced it will close German cultural centers, including Goethe-Instituts, following Germany's decision to close Russian cultural facilities in Leipzig amid escalating tensions. These developments occur as US envoys are expected in Kyiv for talks.
